name: City of Reno Red Cross Lifeguarding Class
org: City of Reno Parks and Recreation, Aquatics
what_you_do: Take the Red Cross lifeguard class at Moana Springs. You earn a lifeguard certificate, plus CPR/AED and first aid certificates.
who_can_apply: You must be 15 by the final scheduled session. You must also pass a swim test. Swim 150 yards, then tread water for 2 minutes using only your legs. Swim 50 yards. Then finish a timed event in 1 minute 40 seconds: a 20 yard swim, a dive to 10 feet for a 10 pound object, a swim back, and an exit without a ladder.
pay_detail: The class costs $140. The page says the city will certify you for free if you are hired and onboarded by the class start date.
duration: In-person class days run 9am to 3:30pm. The class is blended, with online lecture and in-class training.
deadline_text: No application deadline is stated. The 2026 class dates run from Sept 19 to Dec 24, 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the Register Online button for a class, or join the interest list by email. To get the free certificate, apply online for a city job. Be onboarded by the class start date.
notes: You must attend every day of the class to be certified. A shorter $124 renewal class is for people with a valid lifeguard certificate, or one that ended in the last 30 days. The program page does not say if a work permit is needed.
